references.text: The tithe of everything in the land belongs to the Lord and is holy to him. This is the basis for the Levites receiving the tithe as their inheritance.
Repetition of the law concerning the tithe, including the provision that the Levite shall receive a share because he has no inheritance with you.
The Levites shall have no inheritance among the Israelites because the Lord himself is their inheritance.
Confirmation that the tribe of Levi received no land as an inheritance, because the offerings of the Lord are their inheritance.
The Levites did not receive any part of the land as an inheritance, but cities to live in and pasturelands for their livestock.
Nehemiah restored the system of giving tithes to the Levites after it had been neglected.
The book of Hebrews refers to the fact that the sons of Levi, who serve as priests, have a commandment in the law to collect tithes from the people.
